old: Preset styles and prompt guidance shape results; prompt strength controls prompt influence.
new: AI Render offers preset prompts, including an Auto option, and published guidance for writing custom text prompts.
reason: Page covers presets and prompt best practice; no prompt-strength control is documented on it.

old: Outputs are saved to a Gallery and can be shared or exported.
new: AI Render output can be saved for use outside SketchUp.
reason: Cited page only states saving/export; Gallery and sharing appear as links, not described.

old: AI Render is available on desktop, web and iPad with platform-specific steps.
new: The AI Render technical notes describe a latent text-to-image diffusion model and state that copyright of generated images varies by jurisdiction.
reason: Cited page has no platform availability (desktop/web/iPad) content; platform steps need another source page.

old: FAQ covers data use, ownership and availability.
new: The AI FAQ states that Help is free while all other AI features need a subscription plus Trimble Credits, and that results are not guaranteed.
reason: Cited FAQ page does not cover data use or ownership.

old: AI generates PBR materials from text or images.
new: Generate Textures creates PBR maps (metalness, roughness, normal, ambient occlusion) for a material that lacks them; the values can be adjusted or regenerated.
reason: Page documents texture-map generation for an existing material, not material generation from text or images.

old: AI Materials
new: AI Materials: Generate Textures (PBR maps for an existing material)
reason: Match the page.

old: AI Materials generates materials from prompts or images.
new: Generate Textures creates PBR maps (metalness, roughness, normal, ambient occlusion) for a selected material that lacks them.
reason: Page documents texture-map generation for an existing material, not generation from prompts or images.

old: AI Materials
new: AI Materials: Generate Textures (PBR maps)
reason: Match the page.

old: Analysis mode and the entity palette select surfaces for analysis.
new: Analysis mode offers four mode options, location setup and a Properties tab for the analysis session.
reason: Entity palette appears only as a navigation link; surface selection is not described on the cited page.

old: Sefaira web app evaluated building energy and daylight inside SketchUp.
new: Sefaira is a separate subscription service reporting energy, carbon, thermal comfort and daylight for SketchUp models; it is not part of SketchUp plans.
reason: Page does not say Sefaira is retired and states it is available as a standalone subscription.

old: Sefaira (retired energy analysis)
new: Sefaira (standalone energy analysis)
reason: Ref said retired; page says standalone subscription.

old: Imports with metadata for analysis.
new: The Revit Importer brings geometry, materials, textures, levels, tags and BIM data into SketchUp (Windows only; Pro Scan, Pro Advanced Workflows or Studio subscription).
reason: Page does not say imported metadata feeds analysis; it links to a separate metadata article.

old: Access levels: Owner, View Scenes, Comment, View Model, No Access (request flow)
new: Access levels: private invite Owner, View Scenes, Comment; General Access No Access, View Scenes, View Model (request flow)
reason: Ref merged two separate access-level sets into five levels.

old: Meta Quest viewing and Apple Vision Pro Spatial Preview extension.
new: Meta Quest viewing lets users move through a model at full scale with scenes, tags and Entity Info; the Quest viewer stopped being downloadable on 16 September 2025.
reason: Page has no Apple Vision Pro or Spatial Preview detail and no 250k triangle guidance, and states the viewer is discontinued.

old: Sign-in, license types, login frequency and offline usage, MFA, passkeys.
new: The login-frequency page explains that SketchUp re-validates the licence about every 28 days and gives Windows and macOS steps for repeated sign-in prompts and offline use.
reason: License types, MFA and passkeys appear only as navigation links on this page.

old: Drawing a line across an existing face splits it into faces; drawing across existing edges inserts vertices at crossings.
new: Drawing a line or curve on an existing face splits that face into separate faces.
reason: Page does not state that vertices are inserted where a line crosses existing edges.

old: 3-Point Arc draws an arc through a pivot start and two end points.
new: 3-Point Arc: the first click sets the start, the second sets a pivot point, and the third defines the end point.
reason: Statement wording was garbled and untestable; page describes the click sequence.

old: Edit menu can delete all guides and View can hide them.
new: Edit > Delete Guides removes all guides at once; selected guides can be hidden with Edit > Hide and restored with Edit > Unhide.
reason: Page documents hiding via the Edit menu, not a View-menu hide.

old: Axes tool repositions and rotates the model drawing axes, with context-menu Place Axes and Reset.
new: The Axes tool moves the drawing origin and sets the axis directions; its context menu offers Align Axes, Move, Reset and Hide.
reason: Page lists those context items; there is no Place Axes entry.

old: Section Plane creates cutting planes with active/inactive state, display of plane, cut and fill, reverse and align view; cuts affect all geometry.
new: Several section planes can coexist but only one is the active cut in each group or component context; the context menu reverses a plane or aligns the view to it, and display toggles hide planes or cuts.
reason: Page says cuts are scoped to each group/component context, contradicting "cuts affect all geometry".

old: Camera menu selects perspective, parallel, two-point perspective, FOV or focal length and image aspect.
new: Camera menu selects perspective, parallel projection or two-point perspective, and Field of View can be set in degrees or millimetres.
reason: Image aspect ratio is not on the cited page.

old: Math functions (ABS, CEILING, FLOOR, INT, ROUND, SQRT, EXP, LN, LOG10, MOD, PI, RAND, TRIG...)
new: Math functions (ABS, CEILING, DEGREES, EVEN, EXP, FLOOR, INT, ISEVEN, ISODD, LN, LOG10, ODD, PI, RADIANS, RAND, RANDBETWEEN, ROUND, SIGN, SQRT)
reason: MOD and trigonometry names are not in the page list.

old: SketchUp-specific functions (CURRENT, OPTIONINDEX, OPTIONLABEL, SMALL, LARGE, NEAREST, ...)
new: SketchUp-specific functions (CHOOSE, CURRENT, EDGES, FACEAREA, FACES, LARGEST, LAT, LNG, NEAREST, OPTIONINDEX, OPTIONLABEL, SMALLEST, SUNANGLE, SUNELEVATION)
reason: Page names LARGEST and SMALLEST, not LARGE and SMALL.

old: SketchUp-specific functions refer to current values, options and nearest values.
new: SketchUp-specific attribute functions return current values, option index or label, nearest, largest and smallest values, face and edge counts and areas, latitude, longitude and sun angle or elevation.
reason: Statement should reflect the 14 documented functions.

old: onClick expressions animate attribute changes across scenes.
new: The onClick ANIMATE function steps an attribute to the next value in a list of parameters; GOTOSCENE, SET, ALERT and REDRAW are the other documented onClick functions.
reason: Page does not say ANIMATE works across scenes.

old: 2026.1.2 and 2026.1.3 fix security issues in Dynamic Components; formulas must not execute code.
new: The 2026.1.2 release notes list security updates for Dynamic Components without further detail.
reason: Page gives no detail, nothing about formulas being barred from running code, and 2026.1.3 is on a separate page.

old: Extension Manager lists extensions, installs .rbz packages and toggles loading; updated UI in 2026.2.
new: Extension Manager enables or disables extensions with a Home-tab toggle, and updates or uninstalls them from the Manage tab, showing signature and developer details.
reason: Page documents no .rbz install and no 2026.2 UI change.

old: Extensions migrate across versions with a compatibility process.
new: The Extension Migrator developer guide explains how to structure the root .rb file so the migrator can read name, description and creator, and advises a licence reminder for paid extensions after migration.
reason: Page has no cross-version compatibility process.

old: Developer submission, versions and download statistics.
new: Developers must apply for Developer status on Extension Warehouse before posting extensions, which go through its review process.
reason: Versions and download statistics are not on the cited page.

old: HtmlDialog isolates web content with callbacks and no unsafe eval.
new: HtmlDialog add_action_callback lets JavaScript call Ruby asynchronously through sketchup.<name>; callbacks are cleared when the dialog closes and, from 2027.0, can return data through onCompleted.
reason: Page says nothing about isolation, sandboxing or unsafe eval.

old: Rotate uses a protractor to rotate a selection about a point and axis, with typed angle or slope, copy mode and multiple copies by Ctrl and typed count.
new: Rotate shows a protractor and accepts a typed angle in the Measurements box; arrow keys and Shift choose and lock the rotation plane.
reason: Typed slope, copy mode and copies-by-count are not on the cited page.

old: Shared library required by the Fredo6 extension family (UI, localization, geometry helpers, licensing).
new: LibFredo6 is a shared, non-standalone library used by most Fredo6 extensions; it provides default parameters, translation, update checks and trace logging.
reason: Page does not list geometry helpers or licensing.

old: Extrudes faces with correct side joints for thick shells of curved or multi-face surfaces.
new: Joint Push Pull is a suite of face-extrusion tools (thickening, classic push-pull, molding) that can select faces across group and component boundaries.
reason: Page does not claim correct side joints for curved shells.

old: Photoreal path-traced rendering extension.
new: V-Ray for SketchUp provides photorealistic rendering by Chaos and is included with a SketchUp Studio subscription.
reason: Page does not mention path tracing.

old: direct-modeling
new: render-anim
reason: Rendering extension; factory direct-modeling is wrong.

old: While drawing, the segment aligns to the red, green or blue drawing axis and is colored to match, with an On Axis ScreenTip.
new: While drawing, a segment that aligns to an axis is coloured red, green or blue and shows an On Red, On Green or On Blue Axis ScreenTip.
reason: Page names the tips On Red/Green/Blue Axis.

old: Inference engine optionally targets hidden geometry, guide lines and soft edges according to the View menu settings.
new: Inference still sees geometry inside soft or smoothed edges; hidden geometry cannot be selected and is shown faded when View > Hidden Geometry is on.
reason: Page does not link inference to hidden geometry or guides via View settings.

old: The Measurements box accepts typed lengths, absolute [x,y,z] and relative <x,y,z> coordinates, angles and counts, applied to the active tool state.
new: The Measurements box accepts typed lengths and absolute [x,y,z] or relative <x,y,z> coordinates for the active tool.
reason: Typed angles and counts are not on the cited page.

old: Cursor infers anchor points of dimensions, text leaders and 3D text insertion points.
new: Dimensions can start and end at end points, midpoints, on-edge points, intersections and arc or circle centres, guided by the inference engine.
reason: Text leaders and 3D text insertion inference are not documented.

old: Best
new: Strong
reason: Best not justified: cited page has no inference-latency content and the 60 fps / 100M triangle claim is unsubstantiated.

old: direct-modeling
new: performance
reason: Statement is a performance requirement.

old: https://help.sketchup.com/en/sketchup/improving-performance
new: (no public source: performance requirement for Dino 8, not a documented SketchUp feature)
reason: Cited improving-performance page does not discuss inference.

old: Model Info Statistics reports the number of component instances and definitions, and the Components panel flags unused definitions so models can be cleaned.
new: Model Info > Statistics offers Purge Unused to remove unused items, and SketchUp asks to purge on each save unless disabled in Preferences > General.
reason: Page has no instance/definition counts or Components-panel unused flag.

old: Auto-save and backups recover work after crashes.
new: SketchUp creates a backup after the first save and auto-saves every 5 minutes; both are configurable in Preferences > General.
reason: Page does not describe a recovery procedure.

old: OBJ import and export
new: OBJ export
reason: Page covers export only (selection, triangulate, two-sided faces, edges, textures, swap YZ, units, .mtl).

old: Imports single-page PDF as an image since 2026.1; exports 2D PDF/EPS.
new: SketchUp exports 2D vector PDF and EPS, which cannot carry textures, shadows, smooth shading, backgrounds or transparency; vector PDF import goes through CAD import.
reason: Single-page PDF import as image since 2026.1 is not on the cited page.

old: Migrates installed extensions and preferences from older versions; since 2026.2 without restart.
new: Migrate Extensions (Extensions menu) and Migrate Preferences (File menu) let you choose the source version and then require a restart.
reason: Page predates 2026.2; the no-restart behaviour is in the 2026.2 release notes only.

old: Send model to LayOut with scenes as viewports.
new: Send to LayOut opens LayOut after saving and creates a viewport containing the model in a new document.
reason: Scenes-as-viewports is not on the cited page.

old: LayOut imports SKP models and DWG/DXF files.
new: LayOut inserts a SketchUp model with File > Insert as a SketchUp model entity.
reason: DWG/DXF import is on a separate page.

old: Document Setup defines paper size and color, margins, grid, units and precision, references and custom Auto-Text.
new: Document Setup has sections for paper size and colour, margins, grid, units, references and auto-text.
reason: Custom auto-text creation and precision are not on the cited page.

old: Freehand draws smoothed paths.
new: The LayOut Line tool draws straight or freehand lines, and the path editor bends lines and shapes.
reason: Page documents no separate Freehand tool or smoothing.

old: Circle, ellipse and polygon with typed sizes.
new: LayOut circles accept a typed radius or diameter and ellipses a typed width,height such as 4,3.
reason: Polygon is a separate article.

old: Circle, Ellipse and Polygon
new: Circle and Ellipse
reason: Polygon not on the page.

old: Standard editing commands including Paste in Place and Lock.
new: The Erase tool, Delete key and Edit > Delete remove entities; locking layers protects entities from deletion.
reason: Paste in Place and a Lock command are not on the cited page.

old: Fonts, size, weights, bullets, indents, tabs and columns.
new: The Format tab sets font family, size and bold or italic where the typeface has them, and the List tab sets bulleted or ordered lists.
reason: Indents, tabs and columns are not on the cited page.

old: Save As exports a definition to .skp and Share Component uploads it to 3D Warehouse.
new: Right-click Save As writes a component to its own file; component files can be shared directly or through 3D Warehouse.
reason: No Share Component command is described on the cited page.

old: Tools create guides from planes and edges detected in the point cloud.
new: The Guide Point and Guideline tools place guides from points picked on the point cloud; Alt helps make a guideline perpendicular to a reference.
reason: Page documents no plane or edge detection.

old: Sample data and workflow tips.
new: The sample-data page offers zipped RealWorks (.rwp/.rwi) point-cloud datasets grouped as buildings, interiors, terrain and miscellaneous, opened from the Scan Essentials toolbar.
reason: Workflow tips are on a separate page.

old: Scan Space converts a phone scan to a model and organizes scanned spaces.
new: Scan Space (Labs, in development) uses Meta Quest 2, 3, 3S or Pro cameras to capture a room and convert it into a simplified SketchUp model.
reason: Page says headset, not phone.

old: AO adds screen-space occlusion with color, distance, intensity and a Distance Multiplier added in 2026.0.
new: Ambient Occlusion has colour, Distance, Intensity and, since 2026.0, Distance Multiplier controls.
reason: Page does not describe AO as screen-space.

old: Web client visualization, real time viewing and materials.
new: SketchUp for Web has Materials, Styles and Environments much like desktop, and its WebGPU engine improves PBR texture display.
reason: Real-time viewing is only a navigation link on the cited page.

old: Model Info Location panel shows and clears latitude, longitude, north angle, and country.
new: The Model Info Geo-location section shows data added with Add Location or Set Manual Location, and Clear Location removes all location data including added imagery.
reason: Latitude, longitude, north angle and country fields are not listed on the page.

old: Estimating height from shadows or camera.
new: Height can be estimated from a photo that includes an object of known height, or by trigonometry: tan(angle) times distance plus eye height.
reason: Page has no shadow-based method; statement was a label.

old: A solid is a group or component with a finite closed volume (no missing faces, every edge shared by exactly two faces); Entity Info reports Solid status, volume and offers Solid Inspector style diagnosis.
new: A solid is a group or component enclosing a finite closed volume with no missing faces; Entity Info shows whether it is a solid.
reason: Page states neither the two-faces-per-edge rule nor volume reporting.

old: Procedural solid tools preserve attributes of the target; booleans carry materials of originating faces.
new: Solid tools keep the target solid's original attributes when adding or subtracting solids.
reason: Material carry-over from originating faces is not on the page.

old: Solid operations apply to groups and components with transforms; nested solids are handled and results are groups.
new: After a Subtract the instance is renamed Difference and Make Component updates the definition; to edit a subcomponent the main component must be exploded first.
reason: Transforms, nested solids and group results are not documented on the cited page.

old: Style Builder is no longer included; existing .style libraries still need to work.
new: Style Builder is no longer bundled or supported (2023 and 2024 still include it); questions about existing .style files go to SketchUp Support.
reason: Page does not say existing .style libraries keep working.

old: Panels and trays hold model management tools.
new: SketchUp provides a default tray with pre-selected panels; the full panel list includes Match Photo, Overlays and Soften Edges.
reason: Page does not list the default tray panels; panel names differ from the ref.

old: Mouse mapping, touchpad modifiers (2027.0), trackpad controls and 3Dconnexion.
new: With a three-button mouse the wheel zooms, the middle button orbits and the wheel plus left button pans.
reason: 3Dconnexion is not mentioned; trackpad is a separate page.

old: Accessibility statement and VPAT.
new: Preferences > Accessibility recolours axes, parallel/perpendicular and tangent inferences; Styles recolour selection, guides and section planes; a Color Blind style exists; a VPAT is linked.
reason: Page has features and a VPAT link, not an accessibility statement.

old: Array: Vector and point math helpers added to Array (cross, dot, distance, distance_to_line, normalize, offset, transform, trim). Public reference lists 22 methods (for example cross, distance, distance_to_line, distance_to_plane, dot).
new: Array: vector and point math helpers added to Array (cross, dot, distance, distance_to_line, distance_to_plane, normalize, offset, on_line?, on_plane?, project_to_line, project_to_plane, transform, vector_to). Public reference lists 22 methods.
reason: trim is not an Array method on the cited page.

old: Sketchup::Set: Simple set collection of entities. Public reference lists 10 methods (for example clear, contains?, delete, each, empty?).
new: Sketchup::Set: deprecated collection of unique objects (renamed from Set in 2014); new code should use Ruby's Set. Public reference lists 10 methods.
reason: Class is marked deprecated and is not limited to entities.
